_comment: Ability tech tree (CC-18): each player level (total skill levels / 5) banks one point; abilities cost 1 point each and unlock CAPABILITIES, not skill levels. Three branches x three tiers; requires names the ability that must be owned first (linear per branch). Effects: stats stack like equip stats; field_yield replaces Constants.FIELD_SCRAP_YIELD; unlock_slot opens a reserved accessory slot; o2_drain multiplies oxygen drain; cold_bonus adds to the suit's effective cold rating; reach adds blocks; hammer_mult scales hammer hits on player-placed blocks; double_yield is a chance to double any scrap roll.

abilities.name: Field Strip
abilities.desc: Careful teardown in the field: scrapping furniture in place yields 75% instead of 50%.

abilities.name: Tool Harness
abilities.desc: Rig a third accessory onto your webbing (unlocks the first reserved slot).

abilities.name: Master Scrapper
abilities.desc: Nothing wasted: every scrap yield has a 25% chance to double.

abilities.name: Strong Kick
abilities.desc: A practiced flutter kick: +10% swim speed, always.

abilities.name: Free Diver
abilities.desc: Slow heartbeat, still mind: oxygen drains 20% slower.

abilities.name: Cold Blood
abilities.desc: The chill stops biting: your suit counts as one cold rating higher.

abilities.name: Long Reach
abilities.desc: Work at arm's length: +1 block of placement and interaction reach.

abilities.name: Rigger's Kit
abilities.desc: A fourth accessory mount (unlocks the second reserved slot).

abilities.name: Demolitionist
abilities.desc: You know where to hit: hammer blows land 50% harder on your own blocks.
